messages:
Maya: Quick flag 10 — sample-retrieval app hitting vector-dim mismatch when using the embeddings batching helper. JS SDK returns 1536 but server model is 1024, downstream rerank crashes.
Jordan: Which model & SDK? paste minimal repro?
Maya: `instruct-embed-small`, js-sdk v0.11.2. Code: `client.embeddings.create({model:'instruct-embed-small', input, batching:{helper:true}})`; logged lengths show 1536. Server payload shows 1024.
Samir: Looks like a parity gap: python SDK pads/trims to `meta.model_dims` while JS returns raw wire vector. Also missing explicit shape in response so clients guess.
Olivia: I pushed a small server change to include `vector_shape` in responses and a `batch_pad` flag on the request. Canary ready.
Paul: Another issue: our retry layer retries on 401 after refreshing token and replays the full payload. Non-idempotent stores end up with duplicate vectors. Seen in a few customer tickets.
Maya: Confirmed duplication on my repro when auth refresh triggered. Also rerank responses differ: some SDKs expose `score`, others `float_score`. Parsers hit KeyError.
Samir: Short-term: SDKs should add a compat shim. I'll add `response.vector_shape` and a `padTo(dim)` helper in python; Jordan can mirror for JS. Also implement compatibility mapping for `score` fields.
Jordan: I'll add `padToModelDims: boolean` option to JS embeddings client default false to avoid breaking existing users. Also add `padVectors(vs, dim)` util in utils.
Olivia: Canary deploy done on staging with `vector_shape` header. DevexBot: v0.12.3-canary deployed 11 (enable with X-Canary header).
DevexBot: Canary metrics look stable. No latency regressions in embedding pipeline.
Paul: I'll update onboarding README in examples to recommend verifying `vector_shape` and to show `padToModelDims` usage. Also document retry idempotency guidance: avoid blind resend on 401 for embedding calls.
Maya: I'll attach a tiny gist repro to the ticket. For now sample app can check `if (resp.vector_shape) usePad(); else fallback`.
Samir: Plan: (1) land server response shape + batch_pad flag, (2) SDK compat shims + opt-in pad flag, (3) docs + deprecation note for alternate score key over 2 releases.
Jordan: I'll pick this up after lunch and open a PR for js-sdk shim + tests.
Olivia: Thanks team 10. Once PRs merge I'll post in #announcements and update the samples.
Maya: Saved a bunch of customer debugging time already. :thumbsup:
Paul: Ping me for the docs patch review.
DevexBot: Notifying relevant owners and linking ticket INF-4123.
Jordan: On it now.
Olivia: Closing the loop after staging smoke passes.
Maya: Thanks all!
